messages.subject: tsDyn: new  Version 0.7-1 available
parts:
Hi

A minor update of tsDyn has been uploaded yesterday to CRAN. The version
0.7-1 contains a few bug fixes, change of the arguments in TVECM() to
have more consistency, and 2 new small functions regime() and getTh() to
extract regime indicator and threshold coefficients. See details below.

Bests

Matthieu

-Change args of TVECM from nb to ngridBeta, from ngridG to ngridTh, from
model to common
-Add functions regime to extract variabl indicating state regime
-Add function getTh to extract threshold values
-Adapt toLatex.setar to handle MTAR models. Still needs improvement
-Fix bugs in TVECM, in HansSeo_TVECM and in setar
